name: rendobar
description: Serverless media processing for AI agents, run on files from your own disk.
long_description:
Rendobar runs media jobs in the cloud and hands back a hosted URL. This bundle is the local server, so an agent can take a file off your machine, process it on Rendobar's infrastructure, and return the result without you touching a browser.

Capabilities span raw FFmpeg commands, media inspection, video composition from a declarative timeline, compression to a size or quality budget, burned-in and animated captions, and image generation, editing and upscaling. Call `list_job_types` to read the current set live: it grows over time, so this description names families rather than a list that would go stale.

The server starts without an API key so its tools can be listed. Tool calls need a key, which you can set below or write once with `rb login` from the Rendobar CLI.

api_key.title: Rendobar API key
api_key.description: Starts with rb_. Get one at https://app.rendobar.com under Settings, API Keys. Optional here: the server also reads RENDOBAR_API_KEY or the credentials file written by `rb login`.
